description: Run a fresh Web Scan audit of a public URL and return its score (0-100), grade, and every failing or warning check with its id, title and fix: the result is complete in itself. reportUrl is a shareable link only when the request carries a signed-in Web Scan token (reports are saved for signed-in users only); otherwise it is null and nothing is stored. fullReportUrl is always present: the full report on the website, to share with the user. Use this first, to find out what to fix on a live page. Takes about 5-15 seconds. Cannot scan localhost or private networks; use a deployed or preview URL.

url.description: The page to audit, e.g. "https://example.com/pricing" or a bare domain.

name: scan_url
title: Scan a URL
